findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:06, the hanging blue garment and the framed picture on the right are separated by the wooden door panels and an olive-green wall strip with a wooden switch. As the man turns left at 00:07–00:08 and occludes the background, the door panels and the green wall strip with the switch vanish completely, leaving the blue garment hanging immediately adjacent to the framed picture. Additionally, the dark open space on the far left at 00:00–00:06 becomes a closed wooden door and wall when the camera pans left.

findings.entity: Blue hanging garment and framed picture
findings.description: After passing behind the man at 00:07–00:08, the solid dark blue garment hanging on the door suddenly acquires a bold white stripe. Simultaneously, the image inside the picture frame on the right changes from the lower half of a bird with partial text ('VO...') into a symmetrical diagram/emblem.
